eyebrow: A shell inside a running container
code:
$ docker exec -it catalog sh
/app # cat config/current.json
{"cacheHost": "redis.internal", "logLevel": "info"}
/app # exit
caption: exec adds a second process alongside the main one -- exiting the shell doesn't stop the container.

code:
$ docker cp catalog:/app/config/current.json ./current.json
$ docker cp ./patched-config.json catalog:/app/config/current.json
caption: docker cp moves files between host and container without a shell -- fast for testing a theory mid-incident.

code:
$ docker stats catalog
CONTAINER ID   NAME      CPU %    MEM USAGE / LIMIT
7f2c9e1a8b3d   catalog   84.2%    412MiB / 512MiB
caption: Turns "feels slow" into "almost out of memory" -- a concrete lead instead of a vague symptom.
